claims: Alexia Jayy was crowned the winner of The Voice Season 29 on April 14, 2026.
Alexia Jayy is a member of Team Adam Levine.
Alexia Jayy is the first African-American female to win The Voice.
Liv Ciara was the runner-up of The Voice Season 29.
Lucas West placed 3rd in The Voice Season 29.
Mikenley Brown placed 4th in The Voice Season 29.
Alexia Jayy won the "Battle of Champions".
Alexia Jayy performed Patti LaBelle's "Lady Marmalade" in the finale.
Alexia Jayy performed Adele's "One and Only" in the finale.
Alexia Jayy's victory marked Adam Levine's fourth win as a coach on The Voice
